folds.test_window: Opened by v1-v5 and the v6 plan; not used to design the v8 re-rankers or the v9 ladder.

folds.name: F2_mid
folds.test_window: Opened by the v6 plan (v1-v5 inner validation); not used to design the v8 re-rankers or the v9 ladder.

folds.test_window: Opened by the v6 plan; not used to design the v8 re-rankers or the v9 ladder.

plan.selection_rule: maximize mean(NDCG@50, Recall@50) on inner validation, identical for every model family
plan.policy_rule: Trained model configurations are selected under the repeat policy. Inference-time parameters (ALS+BPR alpha, all Hybrid fusion parameters) are re-selected per policy.
plan.gnn_cap_rule: If a top-3 GNN configuration selects an epoch within one validation interval of 400, it is retrained on validation with cap 800 and the extended run replaces it.
plan.hybrid_backbones: top 3 GNN configurations by validation score
plan.statistics: Per fold: user-level paired bootstrap 95% CI (10,000) and two-sided sign-flip test (10,000) on seed-averaged per-user metrics. Fold families (own Holm each): confirmatory = Hybrid, Hybrid_LTR, Hybrid_LTR_W, Hybrid_v9 vs every baseline on NDCG@50 and Recall@50; ladder = Hybrid_v9 - Hybrid_v9_MF_Graph, Hybrid_v9_MF_Graph - ALS+BPR, ALS+BPR - ALS/BPR/GNN; ablation = Hybrid_v9 vs Hybrid_v9_MF/no_graph/no_mf; secondary = Hybrid_LTR, Hybrid_LTR_W vs Hybrid.

designs.policy_truth: labels: policy truth (add-to-cart/purchase) of the evaluation users
designs.weighted: labels: every label-period event of every warm user, weighted by the strongest event (hybrid_ltr.TrainingWindow, weighted_labels)

reranker.training_window: inner validation split: features from its training events and the selected MF fit (seed 42) and Hybrid backbone GNN of the selection runs, labels from its label period; per policy
reranker.selection: user-grouped 5-fold CV inside the training window, maximize mean(NDCG@50, Recall@50) of the held-out users' policy truth
reranker.ablation_rule: the settings selected for the full feature set, one fit, descriptive only
reranker.application: fixed models applied on the test to the features of every refit seed (full training period, ALS/BPR of the seed and its Hybrid backbone GNN); top 50 of the candidate pool
reranker.threads: single-threaded (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, as every fit of this protocol)

acknowledged_test_records.784d0fa97912d79b50665c32c3ebf181daff38ae: v7 plan (F4_unseen): baselines and the v1 Hybrid; named in audit/v10_rr_plan.md section 3

plan.purpose: RetailRocket main experiment (audit/v10_rr_plan.md): the v8 Hybrid family (v1 fusion, Hybrid_LTR, Hybrid_LTR_W and their feature-group ablations) and the v9 module ladder (design a02, reported as Hybrid_v9*) on the four v6/v7 windows, repeat policy only.
plan.dataset: RetailRocket events.csv, item_properties part1/part2 and category_tree.csv (as v6/v7); item category and stock flag are the last values before each cutoff.
plan.design_origin: v1 Hybrid: v1-v7 on RetailRocket. Hybrid_LTR/Hybrid_LTR_W: audit/v8dev (RetailRocket first 27% of events, the F4_unseen inner validation), sealed test on Taobao (v8). Ladder a02: audit/v9dev on Taobao only (chosen by the novel development step, kept as the Taobao v9 model), sealed test on Taobao (v9).
plan.policy_choice: repeat only (meeting of 2026-11-02: repurchase demand), decided after the Taobao v9 result in which repeat missed the 10% steps; novel is not computed.
plan.grid_edge_rule: Grids are not widened again. A selection on an edge of a widened axis is recorded in selection.json (grid_edges) and reported as a limitation.
plan.primary_family: One Holm correction over the four folds, NDCG@50 only, on the fold p-values: Hybrid_LTR, Hybrid_LTR_W and Hybrid_v9 each vs the 8 baselines, plus the 5 ladder steps (29 per fold, 116 in all; audit/v10protocol/primary_family.py). The v1 Hybrid is descriptive only. A ladder result is called significant only if its ratios pass and L3 - L2 and L2 - L1 are significant in this family. No pooling across folds.

ladder.criterion: L1 > max(L0), L2 >= 1.1 L1, L3 >= 1.1 L2, L3 above every baseline; seed-mean NDCG@50 of the outer test, per policy
ladder.module_rule: a ranker without a module neither pools its candidates nor reads its features
ladder.training_window: inner validation split as hybrid_ltr.TrainingWindow (every warm user with a label-period event, labels graded view 1 / add-to-cart 2 / purchase 3), features from its training events, the selected MF fit (seed 42) and the selected GNN run; per policy
ladder.objective: LightGBM 4.6.0 LambdaMART (lambdarank, truncation 50, deterministic, row-wise, 16 threads)
ladder.negatives: 100 random negative candidates per user in the training folds and the final fit
ladder.selection: user-grouped 5-fold CV inside the training window (held-out users keep their full pool), maximize mean(NDCG@50, Recall@50) of the window policy truth; each ranker selects its own settings
ladder.application: fixed rankers applied on the test to the features of every refit seed (full training period, ALS/BPR of the seed and its GNN); top 50 of each ranker pool
ladder.baseline_added: CoVisit: the co-visit graph of hybrid_v9 alone (top co-visit scores of the last 10 items)
ladder.graph_gnn: the GNN selected for the stand-alone baseline (its refit of each seed on the test), not the v1 Hybrid backbone
